receipts.workflow: F2 WP505 ControlSnapshot Binding Falsifier CI

falsifiers: A directly constructed ControlSnapshot with an invalid schema must be rejected before it can select an adaptive-compute rule.
A structurally empty ControlSnapshot that cannot be emitted by a valid WP501 envelope evaluation must be rejected rather than treated as a valid allocation input.
contradictions: WP505 claims exact ControlSnapshot identity/digest fail-closed binding, but build_allocation_candidate currently type-checks the dataclass and policy tuple only; ControlSnapshot has no construction validator and the WP505 test helper itself constructs empty synthetic snapshots directly.
completion_deficit: Repository CI for the original WP505 suite is green, but independent repository-CI falsification reproduces a missing ControlSnapshot structural/schema admission fence. Acceptance should remain blocked until exact snapshot validation is repaired and both canonical plus review falsifiers pass.
next_exact_action: Canonical WP505 mutation authority should add a deterministic fail-closed ControlSnapshot validator/binding fence (including schema and structural invariants, or a stronger exact expected-digest admission contract), add regressions, rerun the canonical WP505 suite, then rerun review CI 33222271338-equivalent before reconciliation.
